name: DRY_WEATHER_ROAD_ONLY_YELLOW_DIAMOND
notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheet's two edge figures are the edge strip (ground colour) and edge + black border, as the AS 1743 drawings. Sheet W5-SA115 (outback roads only; 160 pitch). Diamond 750 side, drawn in its 1060.66 bounding square (centre 530.33); yellow, R50, 10 / 30 (edge 10 + border 20).  Lines centred on the vertical centre line unless noted; the sheet dimensions the legend from the centre lines — vertical positions here are the sheet's (checked against the ink at 1200 dpi): DRY 100 D, baseline -188 from the horizontal centre line (top 242), ink 252 (measured 252, x 409-661); WEATHER 100 D, baseline -28 from the horizontal centre line (top 402), ink 581 (measured 580, x 238-818); ROAD 100 D, baseline +132 from the horizontal centre line (top 562), ink 335 (measured 335, centred); ONLY 100 D, baseline +292 from the horizontal centre line (top 722), ink 339 (measured 339, x 365-703).
